digests.name: Five Below
digests.title: Five Below Q2 2026 earnings call transcript
digests.tldr: Five Below beat on revenue, held the full-year guide and flagged tariff costs into the back half.

guidance.detail: FY26 comps +3% to +4% reaffirmed; tariff headwind widened to $40M.

qa.question: How much of the tariff headwind is priced?
qa.answer: Roughly half through vendor concessions; the rest is being tested in price.

readThrough: Freight tailwind should read across to other importers

quotes.speaker: CEO
quotes.text: We are pleased with the quarter and remain confident in the full year.
